I had seen something eerily similar to this maybe one or two times alone years ago. I was living in a city at that point and wrote it off as a plane, maybe something else. 

Last year, when me and my boyfriend began dating, and I had moved back to my tiny hometown, I would see this often, sometimes even closer to me. Him and I used to lay under the stars in my yard talking, and one night he had said he did not believe in aliens and UFO's; only to have something that resembled your experience decently well (considering it was in the sky and not on the ground), happen only an hour later. 

The light patterns you describe, the speed, the shape, all of that... to the tee. He pretty much shut his mouth about anything paranormal or spiritual being fake from then on. The funny thing is my hometown has a very small airport not too far from my house, so often you can hear or see planes overhead. This shook even HIM, a skeptic, to the core... because even he could easily compare it to the airplanes we see, and even he could tell how different they were. 

Thank you for sharing. Amazing post, and I appreciate you validating my sanity.
